races.name: Download The Oddschecker App Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Both APULIA BAY and Time For The Moon promise to be well served by this step up to 1m but the former's profile is a more compelling one, so he's preferred.

  1. APULIA BAY (IRE)
  2. TIME FOR THE MOON

races.name: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
No short of intrigue here despite the field size. BADDADDAN shaped with plenty of promise when fourth starting out at Newbury 3 weeks ago and with that race starting to work out, he may well make the most of the 7 lb he receives from Blessed Voyager. Jeyoush is an appealing newcomer on paper, too.

  1. BADDADDAN (IRE)
  2. BLESSED VOYAGER (IRE)
  3. JEYOUSH (USA)

races.name: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Easy last-time-out winners FREE WORLD and Hope Rising should come to the fore under their respective 5 lb penalties, with marginal preference for the Ian Williams-trained runner. Joanna Hiffernan looks worth a go at 2m and is the other one to consider.

  1. FREE WORLD
  2. HOPE RISING (IRE)
  3. JOANNA HIFFERNAN

races.name: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
races.verdict:
Given the stamina on the dam side of her pedigree, DIANE CHASSERESSE should relish this trip now handicapping and given her stable, she could well be a totally different proposition this time. Beauty Generation, Midnight Media and The Anthony Gover head the opposition.

  1. DIANE CHASSERESSE
  2. BEAUTY GENERATION (IRE)
  3. MIDNIGHT MEDIA

races.name: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap
races.verdict:
MOULIN BOOJ didn't do a lot wrong when second trying to win a Thirsk handicap for the second time 10 days ago and a repeat of that level may well suffice. Grandlad is all speed and is dangerous if getting into a nice rhythm, while Michaela's Boy is a threat at this level if on one of his going days.

  1. MOULIN BOOJ (IRE)
  2. GRANDLAD (IRE)
  3. MICHAELA'S BOY (IRE)

races.name: Oddschecker Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
THUNDEROUS LOVE went like the best horse at the weights when runner-up at Salisbury last month (went for home a long way out in a strongly-run race) so Jonathan Portman's mare is fancied to make amends reunited with her usual pilot at the chief expense of Sugar Sugar, who isn't straightforward but made a winning handicap bow at Epsom recently. Melissa Honey rounds off the shortlist.

  1. THUNDEROUS LOVE
  2. SUGAR SUGAR (IRE)
  3. MELISSA HONEY

races.name: Smarter Gambling Starts At gambling.com Handicap
races.verdict:
SHIFRA was clear with one who was successful on his next 2 starts when landing a turf classified event here in June and looks on a favourable mark back in a handicap. Crazy Plan looked suited by 1½m when second on her handicap debut so this sharper test is a slight concern but she's a lightly-raced 3-y-o who should have more to offer. Chico Dulce, the mount of Billy Loughnane, and Little Tiger also make the shortlist.

  1. SHIFRA (IRE)
  2. CRAZY PLAN
  3. CHICO DULCE

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OURAGAN had a possible excuse at Wolverhampton and might prove the answer if she can recapture the form she showed when second at Newbury prior to that. This is easier than the races Desert Sands has tackled previously and she's feared most.

  1. OURAGAN (IRE)
  2. DESERT SANDS (IRE)
  3. CRIMSON BLAZE

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SPIRIT OF ATHENE had more in hand than her narrow winning margin at Sandown suggests and can make light of a 5 lb rise. Fellow 3-y-os Distant Shore, She Commands and Asset may give her most to do in that order.

  1. SPIRIT OF ATHENE
  2. DISTANT SHORE
  3. SHE COMMANDS (IRE)

races.name: Compare Licenced Betting Sites gambling.com Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
TIGER BEETLE rates just the pick at these weights on the back of a resurgent Chepstow third so edges the vote from Charencey who could have to settle for the runner-up spot once more. 2024 winner Foinix and in-form filly Dinah Myte can also play a prominent role in this open classified event.

  1. TIGER BEETLE
  2. CHARENCEY (IRE)
  3. FOINIX

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
DO BRONXS has slipped to a good mark and didn't enjoy the rub of the green at Wolverhampton last time so edges the vote from Ollie Sangster's in-form top-weight Bone Marra, who went close in the same race. Recent Yarmouth scorer Three Non Blondes also needs factoring in.

  1. DO BRONXS (IRE)
  2. BONE MARRA (IRE)
  3. THREE NON BLONDES

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive finale in which the handily-weighted JACKSON STREET could prove the way to go on the back of a resurgent third on turf here and bag a second C&D success. Leicester winner Gal rates a big threat however, while both Distillation and Aplaceinthesun have plenty to recommend them too.

  1. JACKSON STREET (IRE)
  2. GAL (IRE)
  3. DISTILLATION (FR)

races.name: Hamilton Park 'Hands And Heels' Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
COTAI STARLIGHT is the least exposed in the field and rates an appealing candidate dropping to 5f for the first time given she's not short of pace. She can resume winning ways, at the expense of Hurt You Never, a 3-time C&D winner who ran well in first-time blinkers (retained here) when runner-up off this mark at Nottingham last week. Tanjen drops in grade and shouldn't be taken lightly, either.

  1. COTAI STARLIGHT (IRE)
  2. HURT YOU NEVER (IRE)
  3. TANJEN (IRE)

races.name: Kinrara Gin EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BALDETTI is shaping up well and is selected to open his account at the third time of asking with further improvement on the cards. Harley is considered the main threat, especially now that Sea Mirage has something to prove.

  1. BALDETTI (IRE)
  2. HARLEY (IRE)
  3. SEA MIRAGE (IRE)

races.name: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for SHEIKHNSHAH, who has shown plenty of ability with a trio of third-placed efforts and Julie Camacho's charge remains with potential having been gelded since last seen. The hood is discarded and he can get the better of Upper East, who is worth another chance to build on a promising debut effort having switched yards. Matter of Britain may prove best of the rest.

  1. SHEIKHNSHAH (FR)
  2. UPPER EAST (IRE)
  3. MATTER OF BRITAIN

races.name: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
races.verdict:
RETURN TO UNIT left his previous form behind tried in blinkers when bolting up at Nottingham a couple of months ago and this extra distance should suit. He can win again. Dwindling Funds, Spoken Truth and Strength of Spirit are just a handful of others to consider in a competitive handicap.

  1. RETURN TO UNIT
  2. DWINDLING FUNDS
  3. SPOKEN TRUTH (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On X At HamiltonParkRC Handicap
races.verdict:
SECOND FIDDLE figures off a handy mark and has bounced back to form in recent starts. She could therefore be the answer here, while Sanafi Zabeel and Epidavros may provide the chief threat.

  1. SECOND FIDDLE (IRE)
  2. SANAFI ZABEEL (FR)
  3. EPIDAVROS (IRE)

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for TERRITORIAL KNIGHT, who bounced back to his best when runner up at Ayr last month and can race off the same mark here. Top Juggler and U Sure Do head the list of dangers.

  1. TERRITORIAL KNIGHT
  2. TOP JUGGLER (IRE)
  3. U SURE DO (IRE)

races.name: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
races.verdict:
Sole 3-y-o FAIRYDALE finished well clear of the remainder when runner-up at Catterick last month and remains on a workable mark. She can open her account in the finale. Ebony Maw and Satyress are feared most.

  1. FAIRYDALE (IRE)
  2. EBONY MAW
  3. SATYRESS

races.name: Cummersdale Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
TEES GEORGE continues in good form and he looks the way to go. Hostility isn't one to trust but finally won over C&D 2 starts ago and could be the danger back down in grade.

  1. TEES GEORGE
  2. HOSTILITY (IRE)
  3. PERFIDIA (IRE)

races.name: National Racehorse Week 2026 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROGUE PASSION is a promising filly and can go one better from her last-gasp defeat here 5 weeks ago. Girl Scout is open to improvement back from a break and could be the danger.

  1. ROGUE PASSION (IRE)
  2. GIRL SCOUT
  3. LIZZIE BENNET

races.name: Colin Parker Raceday 1st Nov Nursery
races.verdict:
A competitive nursery on paper, with INFLUENCER MAN fancied to take another step forward and make a successful handicap debut. Concert Pitch might be able to make his mark, while the returning Lauralynn is the only previous winner in the field.

  1. INFLUENCER MAN (IRE)
  2. CONCERT PITCH (IRE)
  3. LAURALYNN (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Community Raceday 13th Dec Handicap
races.verdict:
Successful over C&D in July, GREAT did well to reel in the leaders when also winning at Pontefract last week and he is taken to add to his tally under a penalty. Jenever returned to form on his latest outing and is feared most from 5 lb below his last winning mark, ahead of Another Investment.

  1. GREAT
  2. JENEVER
  3. ANOTHER INVESTMENT (IRE)

races.name: Ladies Night 2027 On Sale Now Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for TALISMANS TIME, who has run well at York on his last 2 starts and could still have more to offer over this trip. He is taken to see off the challenge of Asia Force, with Karl Burke's 3-y-o taking on his elders in a handicap for the first time, while Shipshape can also make his presence felt.

  1. TALISMANS TIME
  2. ASIA FORCE (IRE)
  3. SHIPSHAPE (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again Wednesday 19th August Handicap
races.verdict:
LEELAWADEE shaped best when runner-up on handicap debut at Thirsk last month and she can build on that effort to go one better this time around. Only Dream Big could be the main danger as she drops back down in grade, with Sparkling Pink another to consider from her reduced mark.

  1. LEELAWADEE
  2. ONLY DREAM BIG
  3. SPARKLING PINK
